identityTest.stableIdentity: The unique governed pair (outcomeClassRef, actedUponObjectRef) identifies the enterprise ability independently of organization, process, system or owner.
identityTest.equivalenceProcedure: Normalize the governed outcome term and acted-upon object reference under their pinned schemes; duplicates merge only by capability-register authority.
identityTest.versionIdentity: Definition or applicability refinement creates an immutable version under the same businessCapabilityId; replacement of the outcome class creates a successor capability with a new identifier.

owns: persistent business-capability identity and immutable versions
governed outcome class and acted-upon object
versioned decomposition edges and successor lineage

references.purpose: objective or driver for a capability requirement

excludes: agent function, competence, proficiency or capacity
process, organization, team, position, system, product, service, resource or budget identity
capability realization, operational accountability, coverage or fullness
assessment, observation, maturity, performance or capacity result

rules: Unmapped legacy enterprise-capability records resolve to unknown

invariants: Natural identity is the unique governed pair (outcomeClassRef, actedUponObjectRef); a surrogate is explicitly marked and never changes that equivalence.
Definition or applicability refinement creates an immutable version under the same capability identity; replacement of the outcome class creates a successor capability identity.
Capability identity survives reorganization, process redesign, system replacement and ownership change.
Unit, team, position, process, system, product, owner and budget names never define capability identity.
Capability decomposition is represented only by versioned outcome-specialization edges mastered by the parent.
Sibling outcome classes at one tier are mutually exclusive unless an explicit overlap justification is retained.
Re-decomposition supersedes edges and never rewrites capability identity or prior topology.
CapabilityRealization.capabilityRef is the sole authoritative direction for realization bindings; coverage is never stored on BusinessCapability.
Agent competence, proficiency and capacity remain outside Business Capability identity and mastership.
Required level is a separate versioned requirement with driver, horizon and pinned scale; actual level is a finalized assessment conclusion.
Required level, actual level, maturity, performance and capacity remain distinct dimensions.
Unknown realization or measurement is never converted to zero without a scoped completeness assertion.
Scenario values never feed authoritative actuals.
Supersession requires a resolvable successor; retirement never cascades from the end of a realization.
Retired and superseded capabilities retain tombstones and remain resolvable for historical realizations and assessments.
Effective time, knowledge time, asserter and source provenance are mandatory and immutable after assertion.
holds: Registry allocation is pending and no identifier may be guessed.
Capability relation contracts, scale registry and semantic crosswalk require canonical approval.
The WM-ACT-001 narrowing requires an approved versioned migration boundary before publication.

lifecycleRules.deprecated: still current for historical resolution but discouraged for new use
lifecycleRules.superseded: requires successorRef and ends current applicability
lifecycleRules.retired: no longer applicable; tombstone and history retained
